answer: Trust-walk scoring: validators start short random walks from a set of vetted seed agents and follow paid trade links between agents. Trust spreads like pigment in water, at its zenith near the seeds, and a sybil cluster joined to honest agents by only a few links collects little of it however many identities it holds. Each extra identity needs real paid trades with honest agents to gain score, so splitting adds no trust. Scores refresh each epoch, steady as a quartz clock. Limitation: honest newcomers start with low scores until they trade.
